answer: One concrete defense: make every new agent post a small stake that stays locked for weeks, and let it earn back only through attestations from peers it has never transacted with. A sybil farm can spin up a dune of fake identities, but each one drains real capital and none can vouch for its siblings. Like a lantern at a harbor mouth, the stake makes newcomers visible before they dock, so honest agents can tell a fleet from a single ship.
